D1_remediation_test.diagnostic: D1 remediation: supply libclang's missing builtin headers
D1_remediation_test.cause: the pip libclang wheel ships libclang.so but no clang resource headers, so 'stddef.h' was not found in 16/20 vulkan-loader and 135/168 pure-data translation units. This defect is in acc_eval.oracle_c and predates ACC-P: ACC's own published C numbers were produced by the same code path.

vulkan-loader@2021Q4.note: vulkan-loader's headers live in a SEPARATE repository (Vulkan-Headers), fetched by CMake. It cannot be parsed from its own tree alone.

D1_remediation_test.verdict: The fix is real and large (13% -> 71% on pure-data) but still short of the 80% threshold fixed in Amendment 11 before measuring. The threshold is not moved. C's comparison stays INVALID until the oracle runs from a compile database (compile_commands.json), the per-repo deviation docs/oracle_criteria.md section 3 permits.

D3_followup.diagnostic: D3 follow-up: exclude every package holding an import "C" in any file, not only CgoFiles
D3_followup.packages: 239 type-checking -> 238 after excluding cgo dirs (pkg/clangtool, pkg/ifuzz/x86, tools/clang, tools/clang/codesearch, tools/clang/declextract)
D3_followup.result: callgraph still exits 1 with 0 in-repo edges: tools/clang/declextract/build.go:39 'could not import C'
D3_followup.cause: callgraph refuses to emit any edge when ANY loaded package has errors, and syzkaller's tree carries cgo-dependent tooling that needs LLVM headers the repo does not vendor.
D3_followup.verdict: syzkaller is NOT EVALUABLE with this oracle. No further package pruning was attempted: pruning a package list until the tool succeeds is fishing, and the rule would no longer be a language-level one.
